  RootPackage
  struct NestedPayload
    field label: String
    field pair: (String, String)
  enum TaggedPayload
    Present(String, String)
    Empty
  class CombinedMovingError(val direct: String, val nested: NestedPayload, val tagged: TaggedPayload, val values: Array<String>) : Exception(<1 args>)
  fun throwThroughFinally()
    val direct
      Binary Add
        StringLiteral "direct-"
        StringLiteral "alive"
    val nested
      Call NestedPayload
        Binary Add
          StringLiteral "struct-"
          StringLiteral "alive"
        TupleLiteral
          Binary Add
            StringLiteral "tuple-first-"
            StringLiteral "alive"
          Binary Add
            StringLiteral "tuple-second-"
            StringLiteral "alive"
    val tagged
      MethodCall Present
        Var TaggedPayload
        Binary Add
          StringLiteral "enum-first-"
          StringLiteral "alive"
        Binary Add
          StringLiteral "enum-second-"
          StringLiteral "alive"
    val values
      ArrayLiteral
        Binary Add
          StringLiteral "array-first-"
          StringLiteral "alive"
        Binary Add
          StringLiteral "array-second-"
          StringLiteral "alive"
    try
      throw
        Call CombinedMovingError
          Var direct
          Var nested
          Var tagged
          Var values
    finally
      Call gcCollect
      Call println
        StringLiteral "in-flight-collected"
  fun passThroughUnmatchedCatch()
    try
      Call throwThroughFinally
    catch error: ArithmeticException
      Call println
        StringLiteral "wrong-handler"
  fun main()
    try
      Call passThroughUnmatchedCatch
    catch error: CombinedMovingError
      Call gcCollect
      Call println
        FieldAccess direct
          Var error
      Call println
        FieldAccess label
          FieldAccess nested
            Var error
      Call println
        FieldAccess _1
          FieldAccess pair
            FieldAccess nested
              Var error
      Call println
        FieldAccess _2
          FieldAccess pair
            FieldAccess nested
              Var error
      when
        FieldAccess tagged
          Var error
        arm Present(first, second)
          Call println
            Var first
          Call println
            Var second
        arm Empty
          Call println
            StringLiteral "empty"
      Call println
        Index
          FieldAccess values
            Var error
          IntLiteral 0
      Call println
        Index
          FieldAccess values
            Var error
          IntLiteral 1
